edit_classes.free: Safe to edit (for character rows: while that character is offline). Takes effect as 'applies' says.
edit_classes.derived: Written or recomputed by the server, or a copy the server does not read: editing is pointless or harmful.
edit_classes.revision: A version counter: never type a value; a write that changes the row bumps it by one.
edit_classes.sealed: Read-only: published content checked by hash at start-up, or evidence (ledgers, claims, audit) that triggers or exactly-once rules protect. The UI says why (read_only_reason).
edit_classes.internal: Server plumbing (leases, tokens, hashes, packets, archives). Never shown.

applies.startup: Read when the server starts (or on first use) and kept until restart: edit, then gw251 restart.
applies.login: Loaded when the character enters the world and kept in memory while online: edit only while offline.
applies.per_use: Read from the database each time the feature runs: a change counts from the next use.
applies.hot_reload: Polled by the patched server every 5 s or reloaded with POST /rates/reload: live.
applies.never: The running server does not read it (staging copy, reference copy, evidence, archive or tooling).

gm_monster_attributes.db_comment: Per map+template monster combat-rating overrides. Attack, defence, hit, dodge and critical are code formulas (MonsterCombatProfileCatalog) and only critical resistance was previously database-tunable, so this table is what makes the rest operator-configurable.
